name: TypeSifter for Elementor
author: joshmishell

sections.description:
TypeSifter for Elementor adds Category and Writing System filters directly under the Family field in Elementor’s classic typography popover. Narrow hundreds of Google Fonts before you pick — without redesigning Size, Weight, or the rest of the panel.

TypeSifter for Elementor is an independent add-on. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Elementor Ltd. “Elementor” is a trademark of Elementor Ltd.

Tested with Elementor 4.2.0 and Elementor Pro 4.2.0.

Features

  • Filter Google Fonts by category: Sans Serif, Serif, Display, Handwriting, Monospace
  • Filter by writing system: Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, and more
  • System, Custom, and Adobe/Typekit fonts stay visible while filters are active
  • Soft-fail design: if Elementor’s editor markup changes, Family still works normally
  • No remote API calls — font metadata ships with the plugin

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or higher
  • Elementor (free). Targets the classic / legacy typography popover.
sections.installation:
1. Install TypeSifter for Elementor from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin (Elementor must be installed and active)
  3. Edit a page with Elementor
  4. Open any Typography control → Family
  5. Use the Category and Writing System filters under the Family field
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor’s newer Atomic / V4 editor?

Not yet. Version 1 targets the classic typography popover only.

Does it call Google or any other remote API from my site?

No. Font metadata is bundled as a static file with the plugin.

What happens if Elementor updates and the filter cannot attach?

The plugin soft-fails: the filter UI is not shown, and the Family dropdown keeps working as usual.

Is this an official Elementor plugin?

No. TypeSifter for Elementor is an independent product from Fermentable Sugar LLC.

Why “Writing System” instead of “Language”?

The filter matches scripts such as Latin, Cyrillic, and Arabic (and related Google Fonts subsets), not spoken languages like English or Spanish.

  • Renamed to TypeSifter for Elementor.
  • Added Requires Plugins header for the Elementor dependency.
  • Font metadata now loads as a cacheable static file instead of inline script data.
  • Raised minimum WordPress version to 6.8.

1.0.2

  • Writing System filter uses primaryScript so incidental Latin subsets (e.g. Harmattan) no longer match Latin.

1.0.1

  • Fix Writing System dropdown stacking under Size responsive device icons.

1.0.0
